items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: we'd have a good jam session. Jack was supposed to come in. Believe it or not, I got a call from him last night.

ctx.x: Thanks for your call. Hello. Go ahead, please.

This is Ted Andrews, Doug. Hi. I would like to compliment Pete on a couple of things that possibly a lot of people don't know about. Number one, I've had occasion to work with Pete or ask him favors in a promotional way for New Orleans. We all know that he loves New Orleans. But I've never seen anyone as cooperative that would go out of his way to do things for sports, for a baseball club, for anything that you ask him to do and just take his time out to do it. And Pete's been that kind of a guy all the way…

we'd have a good jam session. Jack was supposed to come in. Believe it or not, I got a call from him last night. He couldn't make it. He couldn't get out of a NBC staff show he had to do. But he was going to come in for the weekend. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. We're sure going to miss him, though. Yeah, well, he's quite a government. Fantastic, man. And thank you. I hope my wife has listened to what you said.
